newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Applicants invited for HK video-on-demand licences.
newsitem.headline: Applicants invited for HK video-on-demand licences.

text.p: The Hong Kong government called on Friday for applications for licences to provide video-on-demand (VOD) services in the territory.
It said it had set out the regulatory framework and general conditions for the licences on its internet page at http//www.info.gov.hk/bcsb.
"The licensing conditions will be similar to those of the existing pay television licences in Hong Kong with appropriate changes to reflect technical and other differences," it said in a statement.
The deadline for submissions is July 9.
The announcement follows the passage in March of the Television (Amendment) Bill 1996 allowing VOD television services.
Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd plans to "soft launch" its own VOD service in July.
The government plans to issue two VOD licences but has said all applications will be considered on their own merits.
